preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access pause/unpause functions

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the pause() function to set the paused state to true. This will trigger the require statement in _transfer() that blocks all token transfers except those involving the owner address. Users will be unable to sell or transfer their tokens while paused, but the owner can still move tokens freely. The owner can later call unpause() to resume normal trading when advantageous.
